method: cProfile of 400 governed requests at 256 devices, then before/after perf_suite runs on the same host

findings.observation: cProfile: _validate_device called 3x per device per governed request (intake, overlay copy via Device(), decide); ~73% of request CPU in validation
findings.change: overlay copies devices without re-running __post_init__ validation; decide() still validates (threat T8)

findings.observation: 60 s soak: p50 rose to 2670.8 us vs 984.7 us steady (nonce cache scanned linearly on every call)
findings.change: expiry min-heap; amortised O(log n) pruning

findings.observation: no network hop, no serialization, one Device copy per device per request; schema validation of the request is O(fields)
pure_match_4096 p99 12852.0 us vs contract 10 ms; cost is per-device validation + sort, linear in inventory
findings.candidate: cache validated inventory per generation and index by class; not applied (changes the T8 re-validation guarantee; needs an owner decision)

findings.observation: burst throughput (874.5 ops/s) below single-thread steady (1170.4 ops/s): GIL-bound CPU work plus the store lock
findings.status: open; scale out by process/site, not threads

zero_copy_kernel_bypass: not applicable: INV-72 moves no bulk data
